answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed metrics on commonly used human annotation datasets for summarization (CNN/DM, XSUM), style transfer (Yelp), and dialog (PersonaChat, TopicalChat)...

answer_2.quote: We compute the sample‑level correlation between the metric scores and human judgments on generation samples. We also report correlations for baseline metrics such as ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore, etc.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the proposed metrics on commonly used human annotation datasets... The annotation dataset contains 1,600 examples from 16 summarization systems; ... human judgments on generation samples for consistency, relevance, preservation, engagingness, groundedness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated generated texts on task‑specific aspects such as consistency, relevance (summarization), content preservation (style transfer), engagingness and groundedness (dialogue).
